findings.issue: The task and tech spec require count_pending() to be called exactly once when get_schedule_backlog_counts() fails, but the current job() also calls count_pending() unconditionally at the end for final_queue_size. A whole-job mock assertion of exactly one call will therefore fail even after the requested planning fallback is implemented, while removing that final read would silently change existing end-of-tick observability.
findings.fix: Clarify that the exactly-once requirement applies only to the planning fallback, and specify how the test distinguishes that fallback call from the existing final_queue_size read; alternatively, explicitly direct the implementation to replace the final read and state the intended observability contract.
